I'll solve this problem from scratch by calculating 66! and summing its digits.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /tmp && python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 66 factorial
factorial_66 = math.factorial(66)
print(f"66! = {factorial_66}")

# Convert to string to get all digits
digits_str = str(factorial_66)
print(f"Number of digits: {len(digits_str)}")

# Sum all the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)
print(f"Sum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
